mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals a tightening monetary policy stance, which raises discount rates and reduces present value of future corporate cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.05 z-score) during periods when FEDFUNDS rises for three consecutive months in at least 80% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) exceeding 2% indicates weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.10 z-score) when GDPC1 YoY change is below -2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 6.5% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which depresses consumer spending and corporate margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.05 z-score) during periods when UNRATE exceeds 6.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent monthly decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) for four consecutive months indicates contraction in manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings visibility and increases risk aversion, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls for four consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.05 z-score) when INDPRO declines for four consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and a fall in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% month-over-month indicates a disinflationary tightening, which increases real interest rates and depresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises AND CPIAUCSL falls > -0.5% MoM
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.05 z-score) when FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL falls by more than -0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Housing Starts index (HOUST) above its 12-month moving average by more than 10% for three consecutive months signals a housing market recovery, which boosts construction-related earnings and consumer confidence, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 12-month MA by > 10% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +0.05 z-score) when HOUST is above its 12-month moving average by more than 10% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by at least 0.3 percentage points over two months signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and reduces profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises AND UNRATE falls by >= 0.3pp over two months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.10 z-score) when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls by at least 0.3pp over two months.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent monthly decline in Real Personal Savings (RSAFS) below its 12-month moving average for five consecutive months indicates increased consumer dissaving, which supports near-term consumption but erodes long-term growth expectations, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to short-term earnings boosts.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS < 12-month MA for five consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +0.10 z-score) when RSAFS is below its 12-month moving average for five consecutive months.
